mapper.insert: INSERT INTO db_restore_record (backup_id, target_schema, status, table_count, table_stats_json, mismatch_json, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, error_message, created_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{backupId}, #{targetSchema}, #{status}, #{tableCount}, #{tableStatsJson}, #{mismatchJson}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMs}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE db_restore_record SET status = #{status}, table_count = #{tableCount}, table_stats_json = #{tableStatsJson}, mismatch_json = #{mismatchJson}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM db_restore_record WHERE status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
